suggestions.title: Ship Compass v1
suggestions.rationale: This is your primary engineering goal. A dedicated project ensures the v1 launch has clear, structured momentum — turning the goal into actionable, shippable work.
first_three_tasks: Define the v1 scope and write a one-page product spec
Set up the repository, CI pipeline, and project board
Build and test the core feature that defines Compass's value

suggestions.title: Half Marathon Training Plan
suggestions.rationale: A structured training project bridges the gap between the goal of running a half marathon and daily action. Picking a race date and following a plan dramatically increases the odds of finishing.
first_three_tasks: Choose a target race and register to create a hard deadline
Select a 12–16 week beginner or intermediate training plan
Schedule all weekly runs on the calendar and set recurring reminders

suggestions.title: Compass Developer Documentation
suggestions.rationale: Things that outlast you need documentation that outlasts you too. Writing clear docs and a README ensures Compass can be understood, used, and extended by others long after v1 ships.
first_three_tasks: Write a compelling README with the project's purpose, setup steps, and usage examples
Document the core API or architecture decisions in a /docs folder
Publish the docs site (e.g., GitHub Pages or Mintlify)

suggestions.title: Base Fitness & Strength Habit
suggestions.rationale: Running a half marathon requires more than mileage — strength and mobility work prevents injury and builds the durable body needed to support a long engineering career and a life of doing hard things.
first_three_tasks: Establish a 2x/week strength routine focused on legs, core, and hips
Add a 10-minute daily mobility or stretching session post-run
Track weekly energy and recovery levels to tune the routine

suggestions.title: Compass Public Launch & Announcement
suggestions.rationale: Building something that outlasts you means people need to find it. A launch project ensures Compass gets in front of real users at v1 — creating a feedback loop that fuels longevity and impact.
first_three_tasks: Write a launch post explaining the problem Compass solves and the story behind it
Identify 3 communities or channels where the target audience lives (e.g., HN, Reddit, X)
Prepare a short demo video or screenshots for the announcement
